fundamental.summary: TT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 69 days.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — small to moderate amounts, junior/mid-tier members
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) with bearish AAII (53.5%) creates contrarian buy opportunity; recent congressional purchases by Democrats suggest insider confidence, though conviction is moderate given transaction sizes and member seniority.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (372.16) with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 69 days adds moderate event risk but is secondary to acute volatility crisis.

debate.key_bull_argument: Intermediate technical bullish signals (RSI14, MACD, Supertrend) combined with extreme fear sentiment (10/10) and contrarian congressional buying create a classic fear-driven contrarian entry opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: VIX crisis regime (372.16), unfavourable macro environment, price below all key moving averages (EMA50, SMA50, Ichimoku cloud), overbought oscillators, zero fundamental conviction, and no triggered strategies make this a high-risk entry in acute volatility crisis conditions.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear sentiment and contrarian congressional activity present a classic fear-driven opportunity, the VIX crisis regime (372.16), unfavourable macro environment, and price positioning below all key moving averages create unacceptable risk conditions for swing entry.
